info.title: API.SH: Deezer
info.description: The Deezer API from API.SH: public Deezer data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

parameters.name: key

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One Deezer album by id, link or UPC with every track: title, UPC, label, record type, genres, release date, duration, track count, fans, explicit flag, cover, artist, contributors and the full track list (ISRC, duration, rank, preview link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-album

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Deezer artist: name, link, picture, album count, fans, radio flag, top tracks, related artists, the newest 25 albums (`albums_total` for all; page them with /deezer/v1/artist/albums) and playlists featuring the artist.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-artist

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every album, single and EP of a Deezer artist, paged: id, title, link, cover, genre, record type, release date, fans, explicit flag. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-artist-albums

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Deezer's charts for all music or one genre: top tracks, albums, artists, playlists and podcasts with chart position (type=all), or one list up to 100 entries.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-charts

parameters.name: genre_id
parameters.description: Genre id (0 = all music, default; ids from /deezer/v1/genres, e.g. 132 pop, 116 rap).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entries per list (default 10 for all, 100 for one list; max 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Deezer's editorial selection of albums for a genre, or its editorial charts (tracks, albums, artists, playlists).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-editorial

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Deezer music genre (id, name, picture), or with `id` one genre with its artists and radios.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-genres

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A genre id, e.g. `132` (pop): adds its artists and radios.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public Deezer playlist: title, description, link, picture, public and collaborative flags, track count, duration, fans, creation and change dates, creator, and its tracks (with the date each was added), paged. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-playlist

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Deezer radio grouped by genre, or with `id` one radio with its current track list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-radio

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A radio id, e.g. `37151`: returns that radio's tracks.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Deezer's catalogue for tracks, albums, artists, playlists, radios or users. Tracks: id, title and version, ISRC, link, duration, rank, explicit flags, 30-second preview link, artist and album. Advanced track filters (artist, album, track title, label, BPM, duration) and the site's sort orders. `total` is the number of matches; pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Deezer track by id, link or ISRC: title and version, ISRC, link, duration, track and disc number, rank, release date, explicit flags, BPM, gain, available countries, 30-second preview link, artist, all contributors with their roles and the album.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-track

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public Deezer profile (name, picture, country) with one of its lists: playlists, favourite albums, artists or tracks, followings or followers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/deezer-user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Profile id, or a deezer.com/profile/<id> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
